description:
Behind Seo Seon-ui’s harmless, gentle face lies a dangerous well of hidden violence. He manages to keep his volatile temper suppressed. That is... Until Ohn Juhyeok, a senior at his university, approaches him with a video capturing a brutal assault from Seon-ui’s past.

Expecting blackmail, Seon-ui prepares for the worst, only for Juhyeok to make an utterly bewildering request:

*“Could you hit me, too? Just like in this video.”*

Confronted by Juhyeok’s incomprehensible and taboo desire, Seon-ui tries to keep his distance. However, he gradually finds himself drawn into a dark, twisted dynamic where pain and pleasure become inextricably linked.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/Seonui)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/benevolent_violence), [Spanish](https://www.lezhin.es/detail/bondad-enmascarada), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/Seonui), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/Benevolent), [Japanese](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/benevolent_violence)

##### Note: All official translations are uncensored, except for Japanese. This series is a global release, meaning all official translations come out on the same day as the original Korean.
